title: My Dog Came Home… Wrong (Part 1) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine your dog has been missing for two days.
You've called his name until your voice broke.
Then, at midnight, you hear barking outside.
You run to the door, and there he is. Bruno. Muddy, tired, wagging his tail.
You hug him so hard he whines.
For the first time in two days, you can breathe again.
You give him his favourite dinner. He doesn't touch it.
Strange. But he's had a long trip, right?
Later, you're brushing your teeth, and you see him in the mirror.
He's sitting in the doorway. Just watching you.
He waits until you finish. Then he walks to the toilet.
And he uses it. Exactly like you do.
You laugh, because honestly, what else can you do?
That night, he sleeps outside your bedroom door.
At three a.m., something scratches the door. Then it stops.
And a voice, very quietly, says your name.
You open the door.
*Bruno is standing there. On two legs.
He looks at you.
And slowly, very slowly, he drops back down onto four.
And wags his tail.
What would you do?
Part two is coming next. Follow, so you don't miss it.
